SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

14. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
